title: The All-in-One Video Gallery WordPress plugin before 5.0.0 does not check a video's publication status before…
description: The All-in-One Video Gallery WordPress plugin versions before 5.0.0 have a vulnerability where the plugin does not verify a video's publication status before displaying it. This allows unauthenticated users to access the title and source URLs of videos that are private, draft, pending, scheduled, or trashed by referencing their ID.
